note: Route B, the pickup, quiet, on engine 0.41.0 (brief 096, Motive's rivals page; recomposed by Keel for Waymark). The Scout listens to the driver; the Tech loops the pickup camera from the cabinet and the Fixer pays the driver inside the loop ($70,000, off tape); the rival car boxes our car in at the square about 2:53; the Scout misleads the lookout about 4:30 (he watches the public door until about 6:45, past Popovic's car leaving at 5:53); the Tech reroutes the patrol at 4:40; the Enforcer takes Popovic from the back seat in the service bay and walks him round to Rocket Lane while the three blow the block's car; the crew springs, the cell fights it out, the Enforcer boards and Go.
